aliases.name: The Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust
aliases.notes: name as cited in items 122 and 123 of the 2021 Termination 278 ('via the entities disclosed on Exhibit A and direct ownership by The Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust')

notes: Self-settled grantor trust dated April 7, 2014 holding Donald J. Trump's pre-presidency business interests during his 2017-2021 term. Modeled here as an intermediate cp_entity (resolves spec open question #2 in favor of intermediate-entity, which the spec already leaned toward) so the chain person -> trust -> underlying-entity is traversable for audit. Three of its many subsidiary holdings are recorded on this pass; selection rationale documented in cp_filing_0003.notes.
